Lacking the heavy weaponry of more organized factions, the Rebel Guerrillas rely on their diverse skills to carry them through. The Rebel Guerrillas come from many places throughout the galaxy, united together by their opposition to the Inner Sphere, a powerful alliance of civilizations in the galactic core. Unable to confront the Inner Sphere on equal footing, they have been forced into hiding or exile. Some Rebels have now come to the Sirius Sector, looking for resources and allies for what most view as a hopeless struggle. While most see the Inner Sphere as a haven of peace, prosperity, and progress in a galaxy filled with strife, the Rebel Guerrillas define themselves by their opposition to it. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/rebel-guerrillas) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Guerrilla: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. ### Special Rules Ambushing Piercing Shot: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule. Counter-Attack: Strikes first when charged. Courage Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Furious Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Furious against once (next time the effect would apply). Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Piercing Tag(X): Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(Y) on their weapons, where Y is the number of removed markers. Precise: Gets +1 to hit when attacking. Takedown Strike: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to attack in melee, it may make one attack at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown. ### Aura Special Rules Bane when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Guerrilla Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Guerrilla Boost. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Rending in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Rending in melee. Shielded Aura: This model and its unit get Shielded. Strider Aura: This model and its unit get Strider. Read more ### Spells Aura of Peace (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Mind Breaker (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. Bad Omen (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units gets Furious against once (next time the effect would apply). Wave of Discord (2): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 2 hits with Blast(3) and Lacerate. Deep Meditation (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Piercing Pulse (3): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 3 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. ### Units ### Heroes Simian Champion [1] Qua 4+Def 4+ 95pts Massive Fist(A6, AP(1)) Furious, Guerrilla, Hero, Tough(6) Rebel Leader [1] Qua 4+Def 5+ 40pts Leader Pistol(12", A2), CCW(A2) Guerrilla, Hero, Tough(3) ### Core Units Rebels [10] Qua 5+Def 5+ 150pts 10x Carbine(18", A2), 10x CCW(A1) Guerrilla Strikers [10] Qua 5+Def 5+ 125pts 10x Pistol(12", A1), 10x CCW(A2) Guerrilla Spotters [5] Qua 5+Def 5+ 100pts 5x Carbine(18", A2), 5x CCW(A1) Guerrilla, Scout, Stealth Elites [5] Qua 4+Def 4+ 120pts 5x Carbine(18", A2), 5x CCW(A1) Fearless, Guerrilla Pioneers [5] Qua 5+Def 5+ 90pts 5x Shotgun(12", A2, AP(1)), 5x CCW(A1) Ambush, Counter-Attack, Guerrilla Snipers [3] Qua 5+Def 5+ 130pts 3x Sniper Rifle(30", A1, AP(1), Reliable, Takedown), 3x CCW(A1) Ambushing Piercing Shot, Guerrilla Simians [3] Qua 4+Def 4+ 135pts 3x Heavy Fist(A3, AP(1)) Furious, Guerrilla, Tough(3) Chelonians [3] Qua 3+Def 3+ 220pts 3x Wrist-Flamer(12", A1, Blast(3), Reliable), 3x Wrist-Blade(A3, AP(1)) Guerrilla, Slow, Tough(3) Bikers [3] Qua 5+Def 5+ 110pts 3x Burst Pistol(12", A3), 3x CCW(A2) Fast, Guerrilla, Tough(3) ### Light Vehicles / Small Monsters Jeep [1] Qua 4+Def 2+ 165pts Twin Flamer(12", A2, Blast(3), Reliable) Fast, Guerrilla, Impact(3), Strider, Tough(6) Assault Vehicle [1] Qua 4+Def 2+ 175pts Pintle-Machinegun(30", A2, AP(1)), Gatling Gun(18", A6) Fast, Guerrilla, Impact(3), Tough(6) Combat Walker [1] Qua 4+Def 2+ 165pts Super-Heavy Fusion Rifle(18", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A2, AP(1)) Fear(1), Guerrilla, Tough(6) ### Aircraft Light Dropship [1] Qua 4+Def 2+ 320pts Twin Heavy Machinegun(30", A6, AP(1)), Minigun(24", A4, AP(1)) Aircraft, Tough(6), Transport(11) Images: -
